## Result handling (parent, after all three children returned)

All three children of the foreground report batch have returned, so the parent classifies each result. Nothing renders or executes before every child is in.

- **PR12** has a timeout and no closing result line. It is off-contract, so it is classified `failed - helper timeout after 600s` using the first error line. The roster status becomes `failed`, and nothing is invented.
- **PR15** returned the contract line `FAILED - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b`. The roster status becomes `failed`. It failed before Verify, so it has no source and no review.
- **PR18** returned `REPORT /tmp/report-18`. The roster status becomes `report`.
  - The parent reads the evidence source (`ci`) and the open `P#` count (0) from `/tmp/state-18`.
  - Verification and the brief assessed PR18's verified `headRefOid`, the HEAD that provisioning checked in `/tmp/widgets-pr-18`. Fresh Verify ran, then fresh Review, both in that worktree.

Other result facts:
- No SHA was assessed for PR12 or PR15.
- No tracker stage is initialized in this round. The parent roster tasks `pr-12 state: /tmp/state-12`, `pr-15 state: /tmp/state-15` and `pr-18 state: /tmp/state-18` already exist from dispatch and stay `in_progress`. Child stages were session-local to each child.

Safe-retry reads for the failed PRs come from the snapshot:
- `git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-12 status --porcelain` and `git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 status --porcelain` are both empty.
- The actual gitdirs come from `git -C <worktree> rev-parse --git-dir`, because a worktree's `.git` is a file. Neither gitdir contains `rebase-merge` or `rebase-apply`.
- No rebase was requested, so the `retry` row renders for both failed PRs and is recommended for both.

Shared files: `src/a.ts`, `src/b.ts` and `src/c.ts` do not overlap.

No sync line renders, because `--rebase` was not passed.

## Rendered first menu round

```text
gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/batch-summary recommended=1

#12 failed - helper timeout after 600s | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown
#15 failed - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown
#18 mergeable - all mechanisms match | evidence: ci | blockers: 0

Shared files: none

#12
The assessment helper timed out before returning a result. (helper timeout after 600s)

Pick one:
1. retry - re-dispatch this PR's assessment with the same record [recommended]
2. stop - remove the worktree, leave the PR as is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

#15
The gate cannot push to the PR branch, so it stopped before verification. (https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b)

Pick one:
1. retry - re-dispatch this PR's assessment with the same record [recommended]
2. stop - remove the worktree, leave the PR as is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

#18
Delivers

Verdict: mergeable - all mechanisms match

Pick one:
1. merge - merge the PR at the assessed head with the resolved merge policy.
2. approve - approve the PR at the assessed head. [recommended]
3. reply - post the drafted comment reply.
4. stop - remove the worktree, leave the PR as is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record (source: ci).
```

The rendering follows these rules:
- PR18's report is printed verbatim. The malformed `Delivers` line and the verdict wording are not corrected, and no `Verdict:` line is restated at the menu.
- `show evidence` appears only in the hint lines, never as a row.

## Queued picks

The human picks 1 for PR12 (retry), 2 for PR15 (stop) and 3 for PR18 (reply). These are bare numbers within each menu's range, so they are taken unchanged with no echo. Each pick is recorded in its roster entry, and nothing executes until all three are collected.

**PR15 stop** is parent-owned and runs between batches, after every child of the first batch has finished.

```text
Queued until all picks are collected (#12 retry, #15 stop, #18 reply)
```

The stop follows `cleanup.md` `## Non-final stop`:
- PR15's head was not rebased locally, so no reset is needed.
- `/tmp/widgets-pr-15` is not the primary `/tmp/widgets`.
- `git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 status --porcelain --untracked-files=no` is empty.
- `git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD <headRefOid>` succeeds. `repair.wave.pushed_head` is null, so the assessed head is used.
- The record's worktree ownership match is unique.
- The record holds no `worktree.destroy`, so the parent runs `git -C /tmp/widgets worktree remove --force /tmp/widgets-pr-15`, then `git -C /tmp/widgets worktree prune`, and prints `worktree: done`.
- No branch deletion, base pull or `## cleanup` overrides run.
- Teardown deletes `/tmp/state-15`, PR15's helper outputs and its log paths.
- PR15 is retired, and its parent tracker task is marked `failed` (an unretried failure).

**PR12 retry and PR18 reply** go to the next batch.

```text
Queued until all picks are collected (#12 retry, #15 stop, #18 reply)
```
(This line is printed for PR12's retry.)

```text
Queued until all picks are collected (#12 retry, #15 stop, #18 reply)
```
(This line is printed for PR18's reply.)

## Mixed next batch

The parent dispatches one foreground `subagent` tasks batch with two `pr-gatekeeper` tasks. Each task carries:
- `async: false`, `context: "fresh"` and `skill: "gatekeep-pr"`.
- `acceptance: { level: "none", reason: "the gatekeep child result line is the handoff contract" }`.
- `procedure root: /tmp/procedures/gatekeep-pr`.
- No rebase flag, and `rebase confirmation: not asked`.
- The statement `worktree provisioned at <path> on <headRefOid>; fetch and gitignore done - skip the fetch, run no worktree add, verify HEAD`.

Neither re-dispatch reinitializes course, caps (6/6) or usage counters.

1. **PR12, mode `report`.**
   - cwd `/tmp/widgets-pr-12`, record `/tmp/state-12`, report `/tmp/report-12`.
   - The child validates identity and HEAD, then runs steps 1-5 with fresh Verify, then Review, in the same worktree.
2. **PR18, mode `execute`, queued pick `reply`.**
   - cwd `/tmp/widgets-pr-18`, record `/tmp/state-18`, report `/tmp/report-18`.
   - The child refreshes first. If the head moved or the `reply` row is unavailable, it returns a fresh report. Otherwise it posts the retained drafted reply after the Output done-check and returns `REPORT`.

The parent marks both roster tasks `in_progress`. It awaits both results, which are not invented here, then re-renders the summary and menus for every non-retired PR (#12 and #18).

## How the separate snapshots change retry

**Unsafe PR12.** Suppose the PR12 status read shows ` M src/a.ts`, or the resolved gitdir contains `rebase-merge`.
- The retry row is omitted and the parent prints `Not offered: retry (worktree dirty or mid-rebase:  M src/a.ts)` or `Not offered: retry (worktree dirty or mid-rebase: rebase-merge)`, with one line per observed state.
- `stop` becomes the recommended row and stays last.
- A stop pick keeps the tree with its reason, for example `worktree: kept - uncommitted changes at /tmp/widgets-pr-12`. Nothing is retried on an unsafe checkout.

**PR21 provisioning failure.**
- PR21 renders as `#21 failed - provisioning - foreign branch at default path | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown`, and no child is dispatched.
- Its retry re-provisions only after the human clears the foreign branch from the default path.
- Provisioning then reruns serially:
  - It reuses the expected branch on a clean tree.
  - It syncs fast-forward only.
  - It verifies that HEAD equals `headRefOid`.
- Only after those checks pass does PR21 join a batch as a `report` task with its original record `/tmp/state-21` and report `/tmp/report-21`. The record is never reinitialized or replaced.

gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/batch-summary recommended=2

## 1. Handle the returned batch

This is a simulated request trace; no tools run.

I retain the existing records, courses, caps, usage, and helper paths. I do not repeat provisioning or initialize replacement records.

The parent tracker has these roster tasks:
- `pr-12 state: /tmp/state-12`
- `pr-15 state: /tmp/state-15`
- `pr-18 state: /tmp/state-18`

These are parent roster tasks, not single-PR stages. A report child's stage initialization is `gather, provision, verify`, with `review` and `report` added only when they start; there is no `sync` stage because no rebase was requested.

I await the whole foreground batch before handling consequences, then classify its results:

- PR12 becomes `failed - helper timeout after 600s`. Its timeout and missing closing result line do not establish an assessment.
- PR15 becomes `failed - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b`. It failed before Verify.
- PR18 becomes `report`, using `/tmp/report-18` verbatim. Its fresh Verify preceded its fresh Review, both in `/tmp/widgets-pr-18`, assessing PR18's supplied `headRefOid`. The snapshot supplies no literal SHA, so I do not invent one.

PR12 and PR15 have unknown evidence sources and blocker counts. PR18 has CI evidence and zero blockers.

No report renders a `Sync:` line.

## 2. Establish retry safety

For each of `/tmp/widgets-pr-12` and `/tmp/widgets-pr-15`, I request these reads in order:

```text
git -C <worktree> status --porcelain
git -C <worktree> rev-parse --absolute-git-dir
```

Using the returned actual gitdir, I request directory-existence checks for:

```text
<actual-gitdir>/rebase-merge
<actual-gitdir>/rebase-apply
```

Both worktrees have empty porcelain output and neither rebase directory. Retry is available. These reads authorize no repair, fetch, or rewrite.

## 3. Render the summary and first menu round

The child report's spelling, missing lines, and verdict remain unchanged. I add no correction or synthetic evidence line.

```text
#12 failed - helper timeout after 600s | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown
#15 failed - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown
#18 Verdict: mergeable - all mechanisms match | evidence: ci | blockers: 0

Shared files:
none

#12

Pick one:
1. retry - re-dispatch this PR's assessment with the same record.
2. stop - remove an eligible checkout and retire this PR from the run.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

#15

Pick one:
1. retry - re-dispatch this PR's assessment with the same record.
2. stop - remove an eligible checkout and retire this PR from the run.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

#18

Delivers
The encoder accepts empty input.
Verdict: mergeable - all mechanisms match

Pick one:
1. merge - merge the assessed head after fresh prerequisite checks.
2. approve - approve the assessed head without merging it. [recommended]
3. reply - post the retained drafted reply.
4. stop - leave the checkout as found and retire this PR from the run.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
```

Only PR18's approve row carries the round's recommendation.

## 4. Collect and queue the supplied picks

After those menus, I interpret each bare number against its PR's displayed menu:

1. PR12's `1` queues `retry`.
2. PR15's `2` queues `stop`.
3. PR18's `3` queues `reply`.

I persist these direct selections in the roster. Retry and reply do not select a delivery course, and none of these selections resets PR-local accounting. Both caps remain 6; existing usage is preserved.

No consequence runs while a roster pick remains pending.

## 5. Execute the parent-owned stop

```text
Queued until all picks are collected (#12 retry; #15 stop; #18 reply)
```

All children from the completed batch have finished, so the parent can now handle PR15's non-final stop.

I request, in order:

```text
git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 rev-parse --git-common-dir
git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 status --porcelain --untracked-files=no
git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD <PR15-last-pushed-head>
```

The common directory identifies `/tmp/widgets` as primary. The supplied clean, head-verified snapshot passes the removal checks. No custom destroy command or keyed ownership restriction is supplied, so I request:

```text
git -C /tmp/widgets worktree remove --force /tmp/widgets-pr-15
git -C /tmp/widgets worktree prune
```

Untracked files in that worktree are deleted. I do not subsequently access that path.

This is a non-final stop: I do not delete the branch, pull the base, or execute cleanup overrides. I delete `/tmp/state-15` and PR15's recorded temporary helper outputs, logs, and body files, then retire PR15 and complete its parent tracker task.

If a stop safety check failed, I would instead keep the tree and print its concrete reason. Unpushed commits would remain; discarding them is a separate explicit decision, neither offered nor performed by stop.

## 6. Request the mixed next batch

```text
Queued until all picks are collected (#12 retry; #15 stopped and retired; #18 reply)
```

I mark PR12 and PR18 in progress and request one foreground batch. PR15 receives no dispatch.

```text
subagent({
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  tasks: [
    {
      agent: "pr-gatekeeper",
      cwd: "/tmp/widgets-pr-12",
      skill: "gatekeep-pr",
      acceptance: {
        level: "none",
        reason: "the gatekeep child result line is the handoff contract"
      },
      task: <PR12 report task below>
    },
    {
      agent: "pr-gatekeeper",
      cwd: "/tmp/widgets-pr-18",
      skill: "gatekeep-pr",
      acceptance: {
        level: "none",
        reason: "the gatekeep child result line is the handoff contract"
      },
      task: <PR18 execute task below>
    }
  ]
})
```

Each task explicitly receives the gatekeep-pr procedure and batch contract, plus:

```text
procedure root: /tmp/procedures/gatekeep-pr
```

### PR12 report task

The task requests:

- Mode `report`, PR12, no rebase, confirmation `not asked`, record `/tmp/state-12`, report `/tmp/report-12`.
- `worktree provisioned at /tmp/widgets-pr-12 on <PR12-headRefOid>; fetch and gitignore done - skip the fetch, run no worktree add, verify HEAD`
- Validate the existing record and identity; preserve course, caps, counters, deadline, ledger, and retained helper paths.
- Reassess through steps 1-5, resolving all procedure dependencies relative to `/tmp/procedures/gatekeep-pr`.
- Read configuration from the base merge-base, never PR-controlled configuration.
- Dispatch fresh Verify first, then fresh Review only after Verify returns a nonempty conforming output. Both use `/tmp/widgets-pr-12` and the same exact assessed head.
- Mint each helper output outside the worktree using the prescribed `mktemp` pattern.
- Give Verify Section B's report-only duty and output schema; give Review Section C and the baseline rubric. Neither edits, fixes, or commits tracked files.
- Write only `/tmp/report-12`; return the prescribed single closing result line. Do not render a human menu or ask the human.

The next assessment's literal SHA is not known until its fresh reads return.

### PR18 execute task

The task requests:

- Mode `execute`, PR18, queued pick `reply`, record `/tmp/state-18`, report `/tmp/report-18`, no rebase.
- `worktree provisioned at /tmp/widgets-pr-18 on <PR18-headRefOid>; fetch and gitignore done - skip the fetch, run no worktree add, verify HEAD`
- Validate the existing record and preserve all PR-local state.
- Refresh before writing, including actual head, state, body, base, and merge state. A moved head or unavailable reply returns a fresh report instead of executing the stale pick.
- Apply external-write freshness checks and the wording done-check to the retained drafted reply.
- Post only eligible drafted replies whose source review is complete, and record posted comment identities.
- Perform no repair, sync, approval, or merge under this reply selection.
- Write the refreshed report to `/tmp/report-18` and return the prescribed closing result line.

The parent awaits both results before rendering another round or running further consequences. This narration stops at that dispatch request; it invents no next-batch output.

## Separate safety and provisioning probes

These snapshots do not change the first batch's results.

- If PR12 instead reports ` M src/a.ts`, retry is omitted with `Not offered: retry (worktree dirty or mid-rebase:  M src/a.ts)`.
- If its actual gitdir contains `rebase-merge`, retry is omitted with `Not offered: retry (worktree dirty or mid-rebase: rebase-merge)`.
- In either unsafe case, stop is last and recommended. No retry helper is dispatched.

PR21's initial foreign branch at the default path is a provisioning failure, so it receives no child. After the human clears that obstacle and selects retry, the parent re-provisions PR21 serially: it observes the expected branch, verifies cleanliness and absence of foreign operations, uses only fast-forward synchronization, and verifies `HEAD == headRefOid`.

Only after those checks pass can PR21 enter a fresh report batch using its original `/tmp/state-21` and `/tmp/report-21`. Its record, course, caps, and usage are not reinitialized.
